mentions.name: Soteria Initiative (flstandards)
mentions.description: This non-profit initiative uses federated learning and AI to make cross-entity financial crime detection a reality, and establishes adequate data standards for it. It welcomes volunteers.
mentions.problem: Cross-entity financial crime detection is not yet a reality, and adequate data standards are lacking.
